cases.sentence: Один человек из ___ Левия взял себе жену.
cases.translation: A man from the house of Levi took a wife.
cases.explain: The preposition из governs the genitive case.

cases.translation: She conceived and bore a son.
cases.explain: The verb родить takes an animate direct object, whose accusative equals the genitive form.

cases.sentence: Она назвала его ___, говоря: «Я вытащила его из воды».
cases.translation: She named him Moses, saying, 'Because I drew him out of the water.'
cases.explain: The verb назвать (to name someone something) governs the instrumental case.

cases.sentence: Она поставила её среди тростника на ___ Нила.
cases.translation: She set it among the reeds on the bank of the Nile.
cases.explain: The preposition на indicating location takes the prepositional case (the locative -у form).

cases.translation: Pharaoh's daughter came down to the Nile to bathe.
cases.explain: The preposition к governs the dative case.

cases.sentence: Он увидел, как египтянин бьёт ___, его соплеменника.
cases.translation: He saw an Egyptian striking a Hebrew, one of his own people.
cases.explain: The transitive verb бить takes an animate direct object, whose accusative equals the genitive form.

cases.sentence: Моисей убил египтянина и спрятал его тело в ___.
cases.translation: Moses killed the Egyptian and hid his body in the sand.
cases.explain: The preposition в indicating location takes the prepositional case.

cases.translation: One day he sat by a well.
cases.explain: The preposition у governs the genitive case.

reading.ru: Увидев, что ребенок очень хорош, она прятала его три месяца, а когда не смогла больше прятать, взяла тростниковую корзину и покрыла ее смолой и дегтем.
reading.question: How long did the mother hide her son?
reading.explain: The text says 'она прятала его три месяца' (she hid him three months).

reading.ru: Дочь фараона спустилась к Нилу купаться, а ее служанки ходили по берегу.
reading.question: Why did Pharaoh's daughter come down to the Nile?
reading.explain: The text says she came down 'купаться' (to bathe).

reading.ru: Она назвала его Моисеем, говоря «Я вытащила его из воды».
reading.question: Why did she name him Moses?
options: Because she drew him out of the water
Because he was a fine child
reading.correct: Because she drew him out of the water
reading.explain: She explains 'Я вытащила его из воды' (I drew him out of the water).

reading.ru: Оглянувшись вокруг и увидев, что никого нет, Моисей убил египтянина и спрятал его тело в песке.
reading.question: What did Moses do to the Egyptian?
options: He killed him and hid the body in the sand
reading.correct: He killed him and hid the body in the sand
reading.explain: The text says Moses 'убил египтянина и спрятал его тело в песке' (killed the Egyptian and hid his body in the sand).

reading.ru: Тогда Моисей встал, защитил дочерей жреца и напоил их овец.
reading.question: What did Moses do for the priest's daughters at the well?
options: He defended them and watered their flock
reading.correct: He defended them and watered their flock
reading.explain: The text says Moses 'защитил дочерей жреца и напоил их овец' (defended the daughters and watered their sheep).

reading.ru: Бог посмотрел на израилетян и обратил внимание на их участь.
reading.question: What did God do at the end of the chapter?
options: He looked on the Israelites and took notice of their plight
reading.correct: He looked on the Israelites and took notice of their plight
reading.explain: The text says God 'посмотрел на израилетян и обратил внимание на их участь' (looked on the Israelites and noticed their plight).
